up: Retrieve activity records for the human P2X7 purinoceptor (target CHEMBL4805). Filter for activity type IC50 with units nM. Only include rows where the compound has a canonical SMILES string and the associated document has a PubMed ID or a DOI. Return the following columns: molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, assay description, exact potency value (standard_value), potency units (standard_units), activity comment, and the document PubMed ID or DOI. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, ass.description, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.activity_comment, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4805' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
